beats.text: OpenAI announced a model it would not release.
beats.note: 'Due to our concerns about malicious applications of the technology, we are not releasing the trained model.'
It was trained on 8 million web pages with one job: predict the next word.

beats.lead: The popular version says it was locked away
beats.note: A much smaller model and a technical paper went out the same day. A 345 million parameter version followed in May 2019.

beats.text: The full model was released anyway.
beats.note: OpenAI said: 'We've seen no strong evidence of misuse so far.'

beats.name: OpenAI
beats.role: Called the release 'a test case of a full staged release process'.

beats.text: The model too dangerous to release was public within the year.

beats.line: Staged release became the template for what came next.
